headline: Dutch police arrest ShinyHunters suspect; FBI warns other members
summary: Dutch police arrested a 24-year-old Amsterdam man on September 15th in connection with the ShinyHunters hacking group, which has claimed attacks on Ticketmaster, Rockstar Games and the FBI. Reports describe flashbangs used in the raid, plans to murder two people found on his laptop, and the FBI calling him an alleged leader — though the group itself denies any connection to him.
